en: More ~/.ssh/config lines now need your yes in a system dialog: RemoteCommand, SendEnv beyond the language settings, every RemoteForward, GatewayPorts, forwards on all addresses, and a ControlPath outside your home folder.
ru: Больше строк ~/.ssh/config теперь требуют вашего согласия в системном окне: RemoteCommand, SendEnv сверх языковых настроек, любой RemoteForward, GatewayPorts, пробросы на всех адресах и ControlPath вне домашней папки.
uz: ~/.ssh/config dagi koʻproq qatorlar endi tizim oynasida roziligingizni talab qiladi: RemoteCommand, til sozlamalaridan tashqari SendEnv, har qanday RemoteForward, GatewayPorts, barcha manzillardagi yoʻnaltirishlar va uy papkasidan tashqaridagi ControlPath.
